{{Otheruses|homunculus}}
A '''homunculus''' (plural homunculi), was a fully formed miniature being created through [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemy]] and science. During the days of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], [[Sly Moore/Legends|Sly Moore]] one of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] advisors, embarked on scientific experiments to crack the mysteries of life. Her scientists's experiments brought forth many deformed homunculi with extra heads and partial appendages. [[Trioculus]] was the final completed part of that experiment.
